tools.name: export_pdf
tools.description: Export sheets/views to PDF via PDFExportOptions. Params: sheetIds array optional (else all sheets), folder, name, combine.

tools.name: export_dwg
tools.description: Export views/sheets to DWG via Document.Export. Params: viewIds array optional (else active view), folder, name.

tools.name: export_ifc
tools.description: Export model to IFC via IFCExportOptions. Params: folder, name, version optional.

tools.name: purge_unused
tools.description: Purge unused elements via Document.GetUnusedElements. Params: preview bool (default true).
